<thought>Based on the molecular formula (C17H9O3N), one carbonyl, one methyl group, and the presence of chlorine, the molecule can be thought of as composed of a chlorinated heteroaromatic fragment and an acetyl‑derived fragment. The plausible neutral fragments that can be joined are a chloropyridine ring (containing the chlorine and nitrogen) and an acetyl group (containing the carbonyl and methyl). Their SMILES strings are “c1ccc(Cl)nc1” and “CC(=O)O”. Both are valid SMILES.</thought>
<final_answer>['c1ccc(Cl)nc1', 'CC(=O)O']</final_answer>
